newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Steadier European feeds start quietly.
newsitem.headline: Steadier European feeds start quietly.

text.p: The European meals and feeds market started slow this morning with sellers offering South American soymeal between $1 and $6 up following Friday's stronger Chicago soymeal futures close, market sources said.
Most other products were quoted unchanged to $2 up in sympathy with soymeal. Bisda were scarce and no trades were reported during the initial stages of the market.

"Higher seller prices coupled to a strong dollar were good enough reasons for buyers to remain sidelined. The absence of UK traders due to a public holiday also put a lid on early activity,"one broker said.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
